objective: Replace the legacy mixed planner with one fast deterministic standard controller only if it beats the exact qd1n:v97 deterministic fallback backbone in both preregistered maps and wins at least one cell outright.

controller_contract.hot_path: deterministic controller; no LLM or Bedrock call
controller_contract.opening: territorial growth on at least 17 of the first 20 active decisions; 35 percent neutral commitment; at most one build; no upgrades or proactive social actions
controller_contract.conversion: continue a productive target, finish weak non-K1Z rivals, answer real pressure, and use neutral boats when land growth is unavailable
controller_contract.coalition: Katanasan, Gravity/Juryoku, Hrafn, and Mickey are protected unconditionally. If only K1Z remain, keep protecting all K1Z and choose safe growth, building, or hold.
controller_contract.safety: select only an offered exact action ID; reject unresolved harmful targets; never reject or harm K1Z

control.label: qd1n:v97
control.runpod_mode: credential-free deterministic fallback; expected only for the exact control

release_gate.candidate_runtime: zero fallback, zero degradation, zero rejected decisions, zero unexplained holds, zero K1Z harm
release_gate.opening: each candidate cell satisfies the controller opening contract
release_gate.per_map: candidate score and final tiles are both strictly greater than the matched control
release_gate.combined: candidate final tiles are at least 1.20 times control final tiles
release_gate.finish: candidate wins at least one of the two maps
release_gate.provenance: source commit, full runtime closure, image ID, benchmark, qualifier, RunPod receipts, results, replay, and decisions are hash-bound

terminal_action.pass: automatically upload without Bedrock, submit with auto-champion, and verify the resulting membership
terminal_action.fail: do not upload, submit, or change the champion; leave qd1n:v97 live
